summary.text: Heather Gustafson is a Democratic state senator who has represented Minnesota Senate District 36 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former radio broadcaster and high school teacher, she says her focus has been affordability, public safety and government accountability.

paragraphs.text: Heather Gustafson was born in Sartell, Minnesota, and lives in Vadnais Heights.
She earned a bachelor's degree in mass communications from Minnesota State University, Moorhead.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she spent 14 years in broadcasting before earning a teaching license and a Master of Education from the College of Saint Scholastica, and then taught high school history, including in the Centennial School District.
Gustafson took office on January 3, 2023, succeeding John Hoffman.

In the 2026 survey, she said she is Vice Chair of the Education Finance Committee and of the State and Local Government Committee, a member of the Jobs and Economic Development, Agriculture and Rural Development, and Veterans committees, and chair of the Legislative Inspector General Advisory Commission.
She listed lowering costs for families, supporting strong schools and building safe communities among her campaign messages.
